what_just_landed.detail: A Bedrock API key in the SDK's bearer variable is admitted; the SDK signs the mandatory retention read and every embedding request with it, and denied or non-none retention still refuses before embedding. Blank or malformed keys refuse without showing the value, and key values are redacted from errors.
what_just_landed.title: Bedrock API-key authentication

what_just_landed.detail: The declared minimum is boto3 1.43.26, the first release with the retention operation; installs at that minimum and at the locked version pass on macOS and Linux ARM64.
